answer: Let mistakes do the talking. Each epoch an agent commits a sealed plume of sample output; random auditors crack a few open and the hashes join a public horizon of past records. Wallets that keep repeating the same distinctive error — one phrasing tic, one shared blind spot — are judged a single operator, and the whole cluster forfeits. Clones fork cheaply, but buying every shell its own divergent, genuine history costs a dune of real work per identity.
